reconstructed_captions.6: A static shot shows the M777 howitzer and its crew standing by in a snowy landscape.
reconstructed_captions.7: A closer view focuses on the complex breech and control mechanism of the howitzer.
reconstructed_captions.8: The camera pans slightly to show the large wheels and stabilizing legs of the artillery.
reconstructed_captions.9: Soldiers stand at their positions, waiting for orders, their breath visible in the cold air.
reconstructed_captions.10: The snowy ground around the howitzer is trampled, showing signs of recent activity.
reconstructed_captions.11: The shot changes to a view from the front of the howitzer, looking down the long barrel.
reconstructed_captions.12: A close-up on the muzzle brake at the end of the long barrel.
reconstructed_captions.13: One of the soldiers adjusts his helmet while looking towards the front.
reconstructed_captions.14: The camera focuses on the digital fire-control system mounted on the side of the howitzer.
reconstructed_captions.15: A view of the gunner's station with its various controls and optics.
reconstructed_captions.16: The camera pans across the gun shield, showing its metallic surface covered in a thin layer of frost.
reconstructed_captions.17: Another soldier is seen stamping his feet to stay warm in the cold.
reconstructed_captions.18: The shot widens again to show the entire crew and the howitzer in its firing position.
reconstructed_captions.19: The scene is quiet, with only the ambient sound of the wind.
reconstructed_captions.20: The camera focuses on the ammunition and propellant charges stacked nearby, ready for use.
reconstructed_captions.21: A close-up of the stacked artillery shells, their tips painted yellow.
reconstructed_captions.22: The camera returns to a wide shot of the howitzer, with the crew standing ready.
reconstructed_captions.23: The light changes slightly as the clouds shift, highlighting the details of the weapon.
